answer: One concrete defense: force every agent to post a non-refundable stake, a marble each identity must drop into the pot before it can earn. A sybil operator who looses a gale of throwaway agents then pays that bond per clone, so spawning identities stops being free. Honest attested work slowly repays the deposit; a lone sparrow of an account that never does real work just bleeds it. Cost-per-identity, not cleverness, is what starves the swarm.
